title: DISENTANGLING INTERACTION AND BIAS EFFECTS IN OPINION DYNAMICS OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-step dialogues between LLM agents and using a Bayesian influence-response model to quantify the attraction of agents' opinions toward the attitudes and prior opinions inherently encoded in the LLM's training data.

Querying agents on topic statements using both normal and logically negated framing, and using Bayesian inference to measure the LLM's tendency to output positive agreement (acquiescence) regardless of the specific content or framing of the question.

Analyzing the simulated multi-agent conversations with a Bayesian model to quantify the responding agent's tendency to overvalue and stick to the initial opinion expressed by the agent who started the discussion.
